terms.name: Customer
terms.definition: A person or organisation that has registered with the retailer.

terms.name: Client
terms.definition: A person or organisation that has registered with the retailer.

terms.name: Paying customer
terms.definition: A customer with a paid, non-refunded order in the last 12 months.

terms.name: Engaged customer
terms.definition: A customer seen on the site or app in the last 90 days.

terms.name: Open account
terms.definition: An account whose status flag is ACTIVE.

terms.name: Net revenue
terms.definition: Gross sales less returns, discounts and tax.

terms.name: Golden supplier key
terms.definition: The identifier that master data assigns to one real-world supplier.
